versions.notes: Faster, steadier Agent chats. Past chats appear at once: the list is read from Codex's own chat index in a few milliseconds instead of asking Codex to scan every saved session (4-10 seconds on a long history), and it is kept between launches. Opening a chat is instant: each turn's message and answer show first, then what Codex did in the latest turn; older turns have a "Show what Codex did" row that loads on click. Large chats (Unity screenshots in tool results) no longer drop the Codex connection. Every chat request has a time limit and says what went wrong in the chat, picking chats quickly always shows the last one picked, chats keep their history after Codex stops unexpectedly, and a chat open in another Codex window (VS Code) says so. The bundled Unity Tools packages are unchanged (Base 0.1.6, Play 0.1.11, Edit 0.6.23, Debug 0.1.4).

A new look for every screen. The tools work exactly as before; only how they look and where a few controls sit changed. The window has a full-height sidebar and one toolbar with the project, the tool tabs (Overview, Play, Agent, Edit, Debug, each with its own colour), Unity's state and Open in Unity. Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) to jump to any project or tool or run a command. Overview shows Unity's state, script errors and a tile per tool. Play's Play/Pause/Step sit in the middle like Unity's toolbar. Agent has a calmer reading column, a timeline of tool calls, clearer approval cards and suggestions on an empty chat. Edit's designer panel is grouped into cards. Debug's script editor has line numbers and C# colours, and New Session opens a small dialog. Settings has a section list and theme previews. New icons, menus, dialogs, notifications and app icon; refined light and dark themes. The bundled Unity Tools packages are unchanged (Base 0.1.6, Play 0.1.11, Edit 0.6.23, Debug 0.1.4).

UI fixes. Play: the View, Device and Zoom labels sit beside their menus again, so the rotate and pop-out buttons line up with them; the rotate buttons have proper icons; the "Connecting" box no longer repeats the sentence already shown in the empty view. Project page: the ··· menu button is visible, and in a narrow window the status line stays on one line. Edit: the empty page's New Design button has a normal + icon. A project whose folder is gone no longer shows "Checking…" forever. Opening a project no longer moves it up the project list under the pointer. The bundled Unity Tools packages are unchanged (Base 0.1.6, Play 0.1.11, Edit 0.6.23, Debug 0.1.4).

Edit: placement options from Unity Edit Tools 0.6.23. Before Codex receives a redrawn piece, Edit measures each way to place it against the design (its own fit, the visible part filling the planned box, and Codex's own numbers) and shows them side by side; Codex chooses. The bundled Edit package and project skill are 0.6.23. Fixes 0.1.0, whose placement_options tool answered with an error because its bundled toolkit lacked the options command. Not yet run in a live Apply.

First release of Unity Tools Desktop: your Unity projects with Play, Agent, Edit and Debug in one window, without VS Code. Add projects or create new ones, Unity Tools packages are installed and updated per project, Setup checks and fixes what the tools need, and the app updates itself. macOS: open the .dmg and drag the app to Applications (it isn't signed with a paid certificate yet: right-click → Open the first time). Windows: run the installer (SmartScreen may ask once).
